symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: The size of the ground set [h] whose three-element subsets index the data.
symbols.quote: Fix the ground-set size $h=100$ and write $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$.

symbols.name: triple set
symbols.meaning: The set of three-element subsets of [h].
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, so that $v=\binom h3=161700$ counts them.

symbols.name: number of triples
symbols.meaning: The number of three-element subsets of [h].
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, so that $v=\binom h3=161700$ counts them.

symbols.name: bank X
symbols.meaning: The first data bank, with entries X_a.
symbols.quote: There are two data banks $X=(X_a)$ and $Y=(Y_a)$, indexed by $a\in\mathcal T^3$ ($a$ here is a triple of triples, not a shift exponent).

symbols.name: bank Y
symbols.meaning: The second data bank, with entries Y_a.
symbols.quote: There are two data banks $X=(X_a)$ and $Y=(Y_a)$, indexed by $a\in\mathcal T^3$ ($a$ here is a triple of triples, not a shift exponent).

symbols.name: bank index
symbols.meaning: A triple of three-element subsets of [h] indexing the bank entries (not a shift exponent here).
symbols.quote: There are two data banks $X=(X_a)$ and $Y=(Y_a)$, indexed by $a\in\mathcal T^3$ ($a$ here is a triple of triples, not a shift exponent).

symbols.name: bank size
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in each data bank.
symbols.quote: Set $N=v^3=4227952113000000$ for the size of each bank, and $m=h^3=1000000$ for the dimension of the label space used later.

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space used on later pages.
symbols.quote: Set $N=v^3=4227952113000000$ for the size of each bank, and $m=h^3=1000000$ for the dimension of the label space used later.

symbols.name: slice index
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of [h]: the varying coordinate of a within a slice.
symbols.quote: Fix two coordinates of $a$ and let the third, $S\in\mathcal T$, vary.

symbols.name: source value
symbols.meaning: The entry of the source bank at slice index S.
symbols.quote: A forward invocation $X\to Y$ takes the slices $x_S$ of $X$ and $y_S$ of $Y$ and must perform $y_S\gets y_S+x_S$ with linear gates, using scratch wires with arbitrary initial values.

symbols.name: target value
symbols.meaning: The entry of the target bank at slice index S.
symbols.quote: A forward invocation $X\to Y$ takes the slices $x_S$ of $X$ and $y_S$ of $Y$ and must perform $y_S\gets y_S+x_S$ with linear gates, using scratch wires with arbitrary initial values.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The central wire for the element i of [h].
symbols.quote: Through central wires $C_i$, $i\in[h]$, gather adds $\sum_{S'\ni i}x_{S'}$ to $C_i$, for $S'$ another triple, and scatter adds $\sum_{i\in S}C_i$ to $y_S$.

symbols.name: other triple
symbols.meaning: Another three-element subset in the same slice.
symbols.quote: Through central wires $C_i$, $i\in[h]$, gather adds $\sum_{S'\ni i}x_{S'}$ to $C_i$, for $S'$ another triple, and scatter adds $\sum_{i\in S}C_i$ to $y_S$.

symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire for the ordered neighbour pair (S,S').
symbols.quote: Side wires $A_{SS'}$, one per ordered neighbour pair, cancel it

symbols.name: initial side values
symbols.meaning: The initial values of the side wires.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

symbols.name: initial central values
symbols.meaning: The initial values of the central wires.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

symbols.name: copy map
symbols.meaning: The linear map copying source values onto side wires.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

symbols.name: gather map
symbols.meaning: The linear map gathering source values onto central wires.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

symbols.name: injection map
symbols.meaning: The linear map injecting side wires into the target.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

symbols.name: scatter map
symbols.meaning: The linear map scattering central wires into the target.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

symbols.name: number of invocations
symbols.meaning: The number of invocations in the three stages.
symbols.quote: A stage covers all $v^2$ choices of the other two coordinates, each with its own invocation and scratch wires, so there are $I=3v^2=78440670000$ invocations.

symbols.name: bit neighbour count
symbols.meaning: The number of neighbours of a fixed triple in the bit construction.
symbols.quote: A triple has $z_{\rm b}=3\binom{97}{2}=13968$ neighbours in the bit construction

symbols.name: complex neighbour count
symbols.meaning: The number of neighbours of a fixed triple in the complex construction.
symbols.quote: It has $z_{\rm c}=\binom{97}{3}+3\cdot97=147731$ neighbours in the complex construction (intersection zero plus two)

symbols.name: bit central wires
symbols.meaning: The number of central wires per invocation in the bit network.
symbols.quote: There are $c_{\rm b}=100$ central wires per invocation in the bit network and $c_{\rm c}=101$ in the complex one.

symbols.name: complex central wires
symbols.meaning: The number of central wires per invocation in the complex network.
symbols.quote: There are $c_{\rm b}=100$ central wires per invocation in the bit network and $c_{\rm c}=101$ in the complex one.

symbols.name: bit wire count
symbols.meaning: The total number of wires in the bit network.
symbols.quote: The bit network has $W_{\rm b}=2N+I(vz_{\rm b}+c_{\rm b})=177176569091445000000$ wires

symbols.name: complex wire count
symbols.meaning: The total number of wires in the complex network.
symbols.quote: The complex network has $W_{\rm c}=2N+I(vz_{\rm c}+c_{\rm c})=1873807244643542670000$ wires

relations.quote: In the complex construction the network keeps its scalars in $\mathbb Z[i,1/2]$, the values of [Fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md), and the neighbours of a triple are the distinct triples with even intersection (zero or two).

derivations.quote: Fix the ground-set size $h=100$ and write $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$. Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of three-element subsets of $[h]$, so that $v=\binom h3=161700$ counts them.
Set $N=v^3=4227952113000000$ for the size of each bank, and $m=h^3=1000000$ for the dimension of the label space used later.

Stage 1 lets the first coordinate of $a$ vary, stage 2 the second, stage 3 the third. A stage covers all $v^2$ choices of the other two coordinates, each with its own invocation and scratch wires, so there are $I=3v^2=78440670000$ invocations.
In the bit construction, scalars lie in $\mathbb F_2$ and $S,S'$ are neighbours when $|S\cap S'|=1$.

In the complex construction the network keeps its scalars in $\mathbb Z[i,1/2]$, the values of [Fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md), and the neighbours of a triple are the distinct triples with even intersection (zero or two).

In the bit construction, scalars lie in $\mathbb F_2$ and $S,S'$ are neighbours when $|S\cap S'|=1$. The central coefficient $|S\cap S'|\bmod 2$ is 1 for $S'=S$ and intersection one, else 0. Injection adds $\sum_{S':|S\cap S'|=1}A_{SS'}$, cancelling intersection one since $1+1=0$.

In the complex construction the network keeps its scalars in $\mathbb Z[i,1/2]$, the values of [Fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md), and the neighbours of a triple are the distinct triples with even intersection (zero or two). A further central wire $C_\ast$ gathers $\sum_{S'}x_{S'}$, and scatter adds $(\sum_{i\in S}C_i-C_\ast)/2$ to $y_S$. The central coefficient is $(|S\cap S'|-1)/2$, which is $-\frac12,0,\frac12,1$ for intersection $0,1,2,3$. Injection adds $-\sum_{S'}\frac{|S\cap S'|-1}{2}A_{SS'}$ over neighbours $S'$ of $S$, cancelling intersections zero and two through the copy. Intersection one is already 0, and the self coefficient is $(3-1)/2=1$, as a triple is not its own neighbour.

Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central values, and $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps. The schedule subtracts $\mathcal J\sigma+\mathcal R\gamma$ from $y$; copies and gathers, making the scratch values $\sigma+\mathcal Vx$, $\gamma+\mathcal Gx$; scatters and injects, adding $\mathcal R(\gamma+\mathcal Gx)+\mathcal J(\sigma+\mathcal Vx)$ to $y$; then undoes gather and copy, restoring $\gamma,\sigma$. The net change of $y$ is $(\mathcal J\mathcal V+\mathcal R\mathcal G)x$, free of $\sigma,\gamma$; by the coefficients above it is $y\gets y+x$.

Run forward $X\to Y$ at stage 1, inverse $Y\to X$ at stage 2 and forward $X\to Y$ at stage 3. At every $a$,
$$(x,y)\mapsto(x,y+x)\mapsto(-y,y+x)\mapsto(-y,x),$$
that is $(X_a,Y_a)\mapsto(-Y_a,X_a)$, restoring all scratch wires
A triple has $z_{\rm b}=3\binom{97}{2}=13968$ neighbours in the bit construction
It has $z_{\rm c}=\binom{97}{3}+3\cdot97=147731$ neighbours in the complex construction (intersection zero plus two)
There are $c_{\rm b}=100$ central wires per invocation in the bit network and $c_{\rm c}=101$ in the complex one.
The bit network has $W_{\rm b}=2N+I(vz_{\rm b}+c_{\rm b})=177176569091445000000$ wires
The complex network has $W_{\rm c}=2N+I(vz_{\rm c}+c_{\rm c})=1873807244643542670000$ wires
